topic: Ellen Langer, Blank & Chanowitz (1978) Manhattan Library Copy-Machine Study: 5-Page Placebic Compliance vs 20-Page Cost Scrutiny
act5_climax_episode: Boundary replications confirming low-cost favors trigger automatic polite scripts while high-cost 20-page favors wake prefrontal scrutiny.
